newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH KPW CLEARS STALPRODUKT FOR PUBLIC TRADE.
newsitem.headline: POLISH KPW CLEARS STALPRODUKT FOR PUBLIC TRADE.

text.p: The Polish Securities Commission (KPW) has approved for public trade a 1.2-million-share initial public offering and 5,525,000 existing shares of steel mill Stalprodukt SA, the KPW said.
The KPW said in a statement on Thursday that the offering's large-investor tranche of 800,000 shares and small investor tranche of 400,000 shares would begin on April 1.
Large investors can for subscribe for between 20,005 shares and 800,000 shares until April 3. The small investor tranche lasts from April 1 to April 8.
Stalprodukt seeks a listing on the bourse's main market.
The firm's main shareholder, the Huta Sendzimira steel mill, currently holds 40 percent of the firm's shares.

Stalprodukt made a net profit of 19 million zlotys in 1995 on sales of 297 million zlotys and netted 14.7 million zlotys in 1996's first three quarters on sales of 226.4 million zlotys. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
